answer: We formulate a mechanism where validators pledge dynamic opportunity-cost bonds collateralized by assets like timber, governed by subgame-perfect slashing matrices and a yarrow PRNG oracle. Under an adversarial gale of identity multiplication, capital required to sustain sybils scales superlinearly against penalties, rendering expected payoffs strictly negative. Consequently, honest single-identity staking strictly dominates identity splitting, ensuring convergence to a unique Nash equilibrium.
